final class ToolCatalog
{
	static final Set<Integer> AXES = Set.of(ItemID.IRON_AXE, ItemID.BRONZE_AXE, ItemID.STEEL_AXE, ItemID.MITHRIL_AXE,
			ItemID.ADAMANT_AXE, ItemID.RUNE_AXE, ItemID.BLACK_AXE, ItemID.DRAGON_AXE, ItemID.ANMA_AXE,
			ItemID.INFERNAL_AXE, ItemID.INFERNAL_AXE_EMPTY, ItemID._3A_AXE, ItemID.TRAIL_GILDED_AXE, ItemID.CRYSTAL_AXE,
			ItemID.CRYSTAL_AXE_INACTIVE, ItemID.GAUNTLET_AXE_HM, ItemID.GAUNTLET_AXE, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_AXE,
			ItemID.LEAGUE_TRAILBLAZER_AXE, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_AXE_EMPTY, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_AXE_NO_INFERNAL,
			ItemID.BRONZE_AXE_2H, ItemID.IRON_AXE_2H, ItemID.STEEL_AXE_2H, ItemID.BLACK_AXE_2H, ItemID.MITHRIL_AXE_2H,
			ItemID.ADAMANT_AXE_2H, ItemID.RUNE_AXE_2H, ItemID.DRAGON_AXE_2H, ItemID.CRYSTAL_AXE_2H,
			ItemID.CRYSTAL_AXE_2H_INACTIVE, ItemID._3A_AXE_2H, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_AXE,
			ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_AXE_EMPTY, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_AXE_NO_INFERNAL);
	static final Set<Integer> PICKS = Set.of(ItemID.BRONZE_PICKAXE, ItemID.IRON_PICKAXE, ItemID.STEEL_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.ADAMANT_PICKAXE, ItemID.MITHRIL_PICKAXE, ItemID.RUNE_PICKAXE, ItemID.NZONE_RUNE_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.NZONE_MITHRIL_PICKAXE, ItemID.NZONE_IRON_PICKAXE, ItemID.DRAGON_PICKAXE, ItemID.BLACK_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.DRAGON_PICKAXE_PRETTY, ItemID.INFERNAL_PICKAXE, ItemID.INFERNAL_PICKAXE_EMPTY, ItemID._3A_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.TRAIL_GILDED_PICKAXE, ItemID.ZALCANO_PICKAXE, ItemID.CRYSTAL_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.CRYSTAL_PICKAXE_INACTIVE, ItemID.GAUNTLET_PICKAXE_HM, ItemID.GAUNTLET_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_PICKAXE, ItemID.LEAGUE_TRAILBLAZER_PICKAXE, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_PICKAXE_EMPTY,
			ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_PICKAXE_NO_INFERNAL, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_PICKAXE,
			ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_PICKAXE_EMPTY, ItemID.TRAILBLAZER_RELOADED_PICKAXE_NO_INFERNAL);
	static final Set<String> CHOP = Set.of("Jungle Bush", "Pineapple plant", "Vines", "Tendrils", "Bruma roots",
			"Rotten sapling", "Sapling", "Thick vine", "Thick vines", "Corrupt Phren Roots", "Phren Roots");

	private ToolCatalog()
	{
	}
}
